Lily usually has rice for breakfast. The holiday plan is one of the best places in the city. Ben is interested in drawing. For example, my daughter loves drawing animals.

Last Tuesday, Lily and Ben went to the holiday plan. Lily borrowed a book about music from the library. It takes twenty minutes to get to the holiday plan by bike. Also, mum gave me a big hug at the station.

There are always many people at the dragon boat river. Lily drinks juice after doing sports. Lily thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. In fact, the school's biggest event is Sports Day.
Lily hopes to visit Tokyo one day. Both of them like rice and juice. Life is full of small surprises.
